problem.title: Assign Cookies
problem.problemStatement: Each child has a minimum cookie size requirement, and each cookie has a size. Assign at most one cookie to each child such that the maximum number of children are satisfied.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and M. • Second line contains N integers representing children's requirements. • Third line contains M integers representing cookie sizes.
problem.output: Print the maximum number of satisfied children.
